## 1. COPY — port this object, do not re-type these strings

The build imports a `sourceHealthVocabulary.ts` shaped like `ingestionErrorVocabulary.ts`:
a strict **zero-import leaf**, presentation only, nothing branches on the text.

| key | rendered value |
|---|---|
| `cadence(30)` | checked every 30 minutes |
| `checkedAgo('4 minutes ago', 6)` | Checked 4 minutes ago · 6 files |
| `checkedNoChange('4 minutes ago')` | Checked 4 minutes ago · no changes |
| `asked('60 seconds')` | Asked · next check within 60 seconds |
| `stopped('3 days ago')` | Stopped reading 3 days ago |
| `lastGood('2 September, 09:14')` | Last read successfully on 2 September, 09:14 |
| `neverRead` | It has not read successfully yet. |
| `quietFold(14)` | checked 14 times, no changes |
| `showEvery` | Show every check |
| `hideQuiet` | Hide quiet checks |
| `degraded` | This source could not be read here — the others are unaffected. |
| `readerOffMember` | Automatic reading is switched off on this server. Watches are saved, and they will resume when it is switched back on. |
| `readerOffOperator` | WATCH_PROCESS_ENABLED |
| `readerOffRow` | Waiting — the reader is off |
| `badgeTitle(2)` | 2 sources stopped reading |
| `badgeTitle(1)` | 1 source stopped reading |
| `attentionTitle` | Sources needing attention |
| `attentionEmpty` | Every source is reading. |

### 1b. cause → sentence → the ONE control (DATA, never branches)

| cause | hard? | sentence | the one control |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token_revoked` | **hard** — stops on failure 1 | Access to Legal SharePoint was withdrawn — the connection needs to be authorised again. | **Reconnect Legal SharePoint** |
| `folder_gone` | **hard** — stops on failure 1 | The watched folder is no longer shared with this connection. | **Pick a different folder** |
| `unreachable` | soft — stops after 3 | The server did not answer the last three checks. | **Retry now** |
| `unknown` | soft — stops after 3 | It stopped, and no reason was recorded. | **Retry now** |

### 1c. per-file failure reasons

| kind | sentence |
|---|---|
| `password` | The file is password-protected — remove the password and it will be read on the next check. |
| `too_big` | The file is larger than this library accepts — split it, or raise the limit in Settings. |
| `unknown` | It stopped, and no reason was recorded. |

## 4. Invariants a later edit must not break

- ⛔ the word **"scheduled"** appears nowhere — it described the request, not the outcome (`BUG-260906-02`)
- ⛔ **"instantly"** and **"on change"** are forbidden — there is no webhook (`SURF-01`, pinned by 234)
- ⛔ no severity word, no exclamation, no mechanism — except the **marked operator half** of the reader-off statement, which names `WATCH_PROCESS_ENABLED` because for an operator the setting name IS the action
- ⛔ the unreadable source renders as a **named degraded row**, never a skipped row and never an error page (`SEED-239`)
- ⛔ the reader-off condition is stated **once**, and does not mark each source individually broken (`D-235-12`)
- ⛔ the stopped mark uses `--color-warning`; `--color-danger` is never applied to a source state
- every tick has a run row; folding quiet runs is **rendering**, never storage (`D-235-07`)

_74 assertions passing at emit time._
